QuestInfo.name: [Kinesis] Jay's Secret Files
QuestInfo.0: Having saved Yuna from the sinkhole, Jay wants to talk to you about future plans.
QuestInfo.1: Jay is suddenly away from his desk. He's said never to touch his computer...but you can't pass up such a rare opportunity, now can you?
QuestInfo.2: You found fun moments Jay had with his friends saved on his computer.
